_about: Clerk Frontend API answers for an emailed code to an address with no account, recorded on 2026-10-26 against the development instance of one of the apps, through a fresh development browser and a Clerk testing token, so no bot check came between. The instance: sign-up mode public, enumeration protection bulk, smart bot protection on, email code for sign-in and for verifying at sign-up, and a password required at sign-up. Kept to the fields the kit reads, with each answer's client left out, the address replaced with a stand-in and ids with stand-ins. signInUnknown: a plain sign-in, as with sign-up off. signInSignUpIfMissing and prepareEmailCode: the sign-in started to sign up if missing goes on to an emailed code as if the account existed. wrongCode: a wrong code. Not recorded, so taken from Clerk's documentation (clerk.com/docs, sign-in-or-up custom flow, read 2026-10-26) and its types and never asserted as Clerk's behavior: the right code's answer for an address with no account (the error sign_up_if_missing_transfer), which the instance did not give for the test code 424242, and the sign-up that the transfer then makes. On this instance that sign-up would stop at missing_requirements for the password.
